Configuration.aaa: Authentication, authorization, and accounting service configuration.
Configuration.appqoe: Application Level Quality of Experience configuration
Configuration.authorization: Authorization configuration. Authorization services check which resources users are authorized to access, and grant permissions accordingly.
Configuration.cache: Integrated Caching Configuration. The Integrated Caching feature is used to cache static and dynamic web application data.
Configuration.cloud: Citrix ADC as SD proxy Configuration and cloud discovery commands.
Configuration.cmp: Compression configuration. The system's feature for compressing HTTP responses to compression-aware browsers.
Configuration.cr: Cache redirection configuration. The cache redirection feature can transparently redirect cacheable HTTP requests to a cache and send non-cacheable or dynamic HTTP requests to the origin server. A cache stores or caches frequently requested web content and serves such web content to a client on behalf of the origin servers, alleviating the load on the origin server farm.
Configuration.cs: Content Switching configuration. Content Switching feature that enables you to direct traffic to servers on the basis of content.
Configuration.db: All the commands associated with database user
Configuration.feo: Front end optimization configuration. The system's feature to optimize Web content for performance.
Configuration.gslb: Global Server Load Balancing (GSLB) configuration. GSLB feature ensures that client requests are directed to a best performing site available in a global enterprise and distributed Internet environment.
Configuration.lb: Load Balancing configuration. The load balancing methods manage the selection of an appropriate physical server in a server farm.
Configuration.smpp: All the commands associated with SMPP.
Configuration.videooptimization: Video optimization feature is used to show (i) the stats of different media types that are being served by the Citrix ADC and (ii) the details of optimization applied on ABR videos
